# package bits

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-canbus/candb/bits"
```

Package bits extracts and inserts bit fields of CAN payloads in the two layouts of CAN databases. It is the small runtime that code generated by package codegen imports, and the core of the candb signal codec.

Little-endian (Intel) fields are numbered as in DBC: bit b is bit b%8 of byte b/8, and a field of n bits starting at bit s holds the payload, read as a little-endian integer, shifted right by s.

Big-endian (Motorola) fields use a linear index counted from the most significant bit of byte 0 (index 0) to the least significant bit of the last byte: the field holds the payload, read as a big-endian integer, at indexes msb..msb+n-1. [MotorolaStart](#func-motorolastart) converts a DBC start bit (the position of the field's most significant bit in Intel numbering) to it.

## Functions

### func ExtractBE

```go
func ExtractBE(d []byte, msb, n int) uint64
```

ExtractBE returns the n-bit (1..64) big-endian field whose most significant bit has the linear index msb. The caller guarantees msb+n \<= 8\*len(d).

### func ExtractLE

```go
func ExtractLE(d []byte, start, n int) uint64
```

ExtractLE returns the n-bit (1..64) little-endian field at start. The caller guarantees start+n \<= 8\*len(d).

### func FitsSigned

```go
func FitsSigned(v int64, n int) bool
```

FitsSigned reports whether v fits in n bits as two's complement.

### func FitsUnsigned

```go
func FitsUnsigned(v uint64, n int) bool
```

FitsUnsigned reports whether v fits in n bits.

### func InsertBE

```go
func InsertBE(d []byte, msb, n int, v uint64)
```

InsertBE writes the low n bits of v as the big-endian field whose most significant bit has the linear index msb, leaving the other bits of d unchanged.

### func InsertLE

```go
func InsertLE(d []byte, start, n int, v uint64)
```

InsertLE writes the low n bits of v as the little-endian field at start, leaving the other bits of d unchanged.

### func MotorolaDBCStart

```go
func MotorolaDBCStart(linear int) int
```

MotorolaDBCStart is the inverse of [MotorolaStart](#func-motorolastart).

### func MotorolaStart

```go
func MotorolaStart(dbcStart int) int
```

MotorolaStart converts the DBC start bit of a big-endian signal to the linear index of its most significant bit.

### func SignExtend

```go
func SignExtend(v uint64, n int) int64
```

SignExtend interprets the low n bits of v as a two's complement number. For n >= 64 it reinterprets all 64 bits.

### func Truncate

```go
func Truncate(v uint64, n int) uint64
```

Truncate keeps the low n bits of v.
